capabilities: Set Show, Hide, or Reveal-on-hover states for UI elements like the title bar, ribbon, tab bar, and status bar
Add custom command buttons with custom icons, colors, and toggle icons to the file explorer, tab bar, and status bar
Reorder, hide, and color status bar items via drag-and-drop
Hide and rearrange mobile navigation buttons and icons
Bind per-element toggle commands to hotkeys
extras: Part of the Vault CMS project; the same developer sells a separate desktop app (Zeku, paid with 14-day trial), which is unrelated to using this plugin. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Toggle-icon auto-sync requires commands from other plugins to implement checkCallback.
problem: Obsidian offers limited built-in control over which interface elements are visible, and no way to add custom command buttons to the explorer, tab bar, or status bar.

relations.evidence: most "hide" features in this plugin are based on this plugin
custom command buttons in explorer and tab bar, command execution interceptor patterns
status bar item reordering, hiding, and drag-and-drop functionality
the "Properties" section and icon management logic were inspired by this plugin

summary: Interface customization plugin that hides, reveals, or restyles Obsidian UI elements and adds custom command buttons to the explorer, tab bar, and status bar.
